item.title: Heber City Police Department test-pilots AI software
item.description: On Oct. 21, Heber City Police Chief Parker Sever appeared before the City Council and informed them that a police officer had shape-shifted into a frog. The post Heber City Police Department test-pilots AI software appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: A test of Heber City Police Department’s AI software
item.description: Using what I knew about AI transcription software, I fabricated a fictional incident I would be testifying about to Sgt. Josh Weishar that included some tricky turns of phrase, slang terms and double meanings that might confuse Draft One. The post A test of Heber City Police Department’s AI software appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Scott Phillips’ Heber City Council term comes to an end
item.description: Phillips isn’t sure whether he will run for public office again. For now, he’s looking forward to a “recovery period” of evenings with his family and what he calls “normal community service.” The post Scott Phillips’ Heber City Council term comes to an end appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Gifts of Love brings holiday support to 54 families in early intervention program
item.description: Through a project called Gifts of Love, the Park City Rotary Club provided personalized holiday support to 54 families enrolled in the Summit County Early Intervention Program, which serves children ages 0 to 3 in Summit and Wasatch counties. The post Gifts of Love brings holiday support to 54 families in early intervention program appeared first on Park Record.

item.description: Cada Play Forever Friday ofrece acceso por 35 dólares a las instalaciones interiores de Woodward o boletos de telesilla por 35 dólares. The post Woodward Park City inicia la temporada de invierno con Play Forever Fridays appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Wigglish rides holiday high
item.description: Wigglish Toys & Gifts in Heber City specializes in “heirloom toys,” toys of quality that can be passed down through generations. December is the busiest season for the business. The post Wigglish rides holiday high appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Hot Laps back at Woodward Park City
item.description: After weeks of waiting on the weather, Woodward Park City opened its Hot Laps lift Friday, giving riders their first real downhill laps of the season following a staggered and delayed start to winter. The post Hot Laps back at Woodward Park City appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Summit County closes on 835-acre Ure Ranch property
item.description: Summit County and the Summit Land Conservancy have officially acquired the 835-acre Ure Ranch property in the Kamas Valley. The post Summit County closes on 835-acre Ure Ranch property appeared first on Park Record.
